source: Traveller Core Rulebook, World Profiles and Starports

tables.title: Starport
tables.summary: Starport class describes port quality, fuel, repair support, shipyard capacity, and possible bases.

tables.title: Size
tables.summary: Size measures the main world's diameter in thousands of kilometres and gives a typical surface gravity.

tables.title: Atmosphere
tables.summary: Atmosphere describes composition, pressure, and what protection travellers need to survive outside sealed environments.

tables.title: Hydrographics
tables.summary: Hydrographics measures the percentage of the world covered by surface liquid.
rows: Only a few islands and archipelagos

tables.title: Population
tables.summary: Population is a scale code. The UWP digit is the number of zeroes following a one, adjusted by PBG when detailed population is available.

tables.title: Government
tables.summary: Government is the dominant ruling structure on the world. The contraband column is a likely tendency, not an absolute rule.
rows: No formal government; family, clan, or anarchy may dominate.
Corporate management governs employees and dependants.
Citizens govern directly by advice and consent.
A restricted minority rules with little public input.
Technical elites govern through mutually beneficial service relationships.
An imposed local government answers to an outside power.
No central authority; rival governments compete.
Government agencies run society through selected experts.
Insulated agencies rule at a distance from citizens.
A single leader with overwhelming public confidence directs the state.
A former charismatic regime has passed to a normal successor.
A trusted select group or class governs.
A religious organisation governs without regard to individual needs.
A single religious leader holds absolute power.
An all-powerful minority rules through coercion.

tables.title: Law Level
tables.summary: Law Level describes how restrictive local law is, especially for weapons and armour carried beyond the starport.
rows: Poison gas, explosives, undetectable weapons, and weapons of mass destruction
Portable energy weapons and laser weapons
Light assault weapons and submachine guns
All firearms except shotguns and stunners; open carrying discouraged

tables.title: Tech Level
tables.summary: Tech Level is the average local technology base. It affects local production, repair, communications, and environmental survival limits.
rows: A local average; wealthy groups or governments may access higher technology than the world average.
No telecom network except what the starport provides.
Radio and telephone links between major cities at minimum.
Worldwide access is normal because communication satellites are cheap and easy to deploy.
Minimum TL8 to maintain a population without outside support.
Minimum TL5 to maintain a population without outside support.
Minimum TL3 to maintain a population without outside support.
Minimum TL8 to maintain a population without outside support.
Minimum TL9 to maintain a population without outside support.
Minimum TL10 to maintain a population without outside support.
Minimum TL5 to maintain a population without outside support.
Minimum TL8 to maintain a population without outside support.
